reviews.title: Omran Sami - RJ flight attendant
reviews.text: Hello, I would highly recommend Omran Sami, flight attendant, he was very friendly, smiling during the whole flight, cooperative when something needed, and took care of passengers. My flight was from Jordan-Amman to Canada-Toronto, it’s a long distance flight and without him I wouldn’t have the same experience I had with RJ. Thank you RJ for hiring high qualified flight attendant like Omran.
reviews.author: Maryam S

reviews.title: Worst airflight ever!
reviews.text: I arrived 13 minutes late exactly at the airport, I was late because we had a flat tire on the road and we were driving all the way from Windsor to Montreal! Imagine 15 hr driving trip! The worst part of it is that they wouldn't let me in at check in, there was no way to get in, and they weren't nice and they wouldn't cooperate even their managers they managed to call, disgusting behaviour and very bad customer service. It got even worse, they didn't even get me a refund, not even a partial one, they wanted me to pay $700 extra for a rescheduled flight couple days later!!! I ended up booking with Qatar Airways which wasn't my first time, and honestly best airways ever in all ways!!! FIRST AND LAST TIME WITH AIR JORDANIAN !!! If there was a (-) review points, not even 0, I would definitely give them.
reviews.author: Zeinab Alkhatib

reviews.title: Just an OK airline
reviews.text: They changed my reserved window seat without my knowledge. At check-in customer service was very bad, I asked who changed my seat with no answer. Second, the airplane boing 787 B Dreamliner without dreams, a beat-up plane with no zero maintenance I had doubt this plane will fly to Amman. take a look at the attached photos, especially the tires. Service during the flight was excellent, as well as the food was delicious and good.
reviews.author: James

reviews.title: Thieves operate in AMM baggage handling
reviews.text: Unfortunately we had a second phone ‘lifted’ from luggage after the bag had been checked in to the baggage handler AMMBAG. The phone was turned on in Madaba a few days after it was stolen and will be wiped thanks to Apple but we were really disappointed with the reaction of airport services who keep questioning what happened. Best if travelling with this airline to keep all your belongings with you! Or choose a safer airline.
reviews.author: Jilly P

reviews.title: Best experience I have ever had! Thank you Moayad
reviews.text: I had a flight with Royal Jordanian Airlines from Amman to London. The flight was on time, the food and drinks were given for free as a part of the ticket price, the service was AMAZING! That doesn’t stop there, each and every flight attendant on the flight RJ111 was extremely nice and helpful however Moayad one of the flight attendants had an outstanding behavior , he went above and beyond, a gentleman who loves his job and care to give the people an amazing service, a gentleman who does it because he cared about his reputation and the reputation of the airlines he works with. For someone who travels on a monthly basis I can simply say, I have never experienced such an amazing experience. There are no words that can describe the impact I had from this experience! Thank you Royal Jordanian Airlines for recruiting people like Moayad!

Secondly, I just landed now, came to attend a very important wedding on the same day, and my bag was left in Amman.Met tge Jordanian airways customer service in the airport, and his answer was this can happen and it happened with you. I was looking at him surprised and I was really upset, all he can do, is just apologise instead of sharing his nonsense words.today is the wedding of my friends which I was going to attend, but it turns that all was full of stress and my suit and shoes which was supposed to be the outfit for this weddings will spend their time in Amman alone. reviews.author: Naji H

reviews.title: Turning day into night on Royal Jordanian
reviews.text: Part of the advanced technology on the Boeing 787 Dreamliner is an automated window dimming system, controlled by the captain, in place of the simple shutters which you pushed up or down to control the daylight entering your window. So you have no control over what you can see and are at the mercy of the captain. Return flight from Amman to London left at 12 noon local time and arrived in London at 3 pm local time, the ultimate definition of a daytime flight. We had barely left the Israeli coast before the captain dimmed the windows substantially, and by the time we reached the Dalmatian coast he had locked us down completely as if for a night flight with the windows electronically "closed" When I asked the cabin crew "Why?", I got a waffly reply about some people wanting to sleep and nonsense about protecting the cabin staff from bright sunlight. The windows would be "opened" in about half an hour, but they were finally opened barely in time for us to see the City of London about fifteen minutes from landing. The whole experience was really quite bizarre and it was positively claustrophobic being shut down as if for a night flight on what was actually a beautiful sunny day. Boeing push the Dreamliner as a highly fuel efficient aircraft but with the cabin shut down and all the lights on in broad daylight there is an additional fuel cost. This is truly the most bizarre and ridiculous policy I have ever encountered in over fifty years of flying worldwide. If you are seeking God
reviews.author: Alan S

reviews.title: Unreliable airlines
reviews.text: Our flight back to Dubai is on Sunday and we absolutely have to be back on Sunday. On Friday midnight they sent us an email saying the flight has been cancelled and they have rescheduled our flight to Tuesday. 1) they gave us only 2 days notice on a flight that’s been booked for months; 2) they didn’t ask which flight back we would choose, and 3) they told us other flights on Sunday are fully booked and our only option is to choose another day or get a refund. We have chosen a refund and are flying back on another airlines on a one day wu ticket as we have to travel back on Sunday. This means we will be paying much more money as we will book a one way ticket.
reviews.author: Rashed

reviews.title: poor very poor indeed
reviews.text: i flew quite a bit recently with different carrier, wow i had a shock when i tried Air France... remind me what was real customer service was all about ie: smartly dress, professional spoken, mature experience staff, great catering offer with CHOICES, comfortable seat, WIFI, all the thing you would want on a plane.... it was amazing & refreshing to experience... then come RJ... i mean you get the complete opposite: the food was awful, disgusting beef Mexican sandwich with dry rice falling out everywhere from the carton container it serve in not even a plate to put your food on, remember folks you pay premium prices of $700 + for this company & should represent the country you are going to visit...that not even the end...you ask 4 times to different members of the staff to get your bag from the over head locker that even before you push the assistance button which was ignore twice. i was ignore for a drink service which was point out by next seat passenger & remind them that i was existed. to top it all, it was announced by the captain before we started our journey that we were welcome with great pleasure from the Royal Majesties of Jordan about the service we were going to get...wow i don't think they want to put their name to this company & service this company is delivering, if only they knew that is the first thing you received before you put foot in Jordan. lots & lots of improvement ahead before bankruptcy knocking on their doors...national carrier at their poorest.
reviews.author: Eric

reviews.title: John Westphal
reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience with Royal Jordanian Airlines. From the check-in to deplaning everything went very well and was well organized. In particular one of the stewardesses whose name is Raghad in Naser, ID number 24321 was outstanding. She had a continuous smile on her face and was very kind, helpful and answered all of my questions concerning our flight and trip. Her extremely pleasant personality made it a joy to fly with Royal Jordanian Airlines. With flight attendants like her a person feels very comfortable and well cared for. I highly recommend Royal Jordanian Airlines and stewardesses like Raghad Naser for a memorable vacation experience.
reviews.author: john w

reviews.title: NOTHING 'ROYAL' about this Cheap, Disgusting, Dangerous  Airline
reviews.text: I have read a number of reviews about their cheap broken planes but I didn't expect to be in one - Seat 17B from Amman to London RJ111 the plane was cheap dirty and dangerous - staff rude and very unhelpful. The seat total came off when you sat or you could just pick it up - Crew forced me or my 2 years old to sit on this and then didn't help at all. I was forced to carry my child on a 5 hour flight. I even ended up cutting myself on the sharp broken metal seat. On arrived to London i complained to the CEO who offered me 35% off my next RJ flight. I don't think this person understand that once you have travelled with RJ you will NEVER travel with them again even for FREE!! I reviewed their airline on google and then got a call to say because i have done this the CEO have withdrawal the 35% discount - the same offer i rejected. I mean how old is the CEO- acts like a child. I would avoid travelling with this dangerous airline. BROKEN SEATS, TAPPED UP SCREENS/ TV, AND RUBBISH FOOD.

reviews.text: Excellent service, great food, friendly crew and a complete positive experience. Looking forward to additional flights in the future with ROYAL JORDANIAN Airlines (Queen Alia) Shookrun..
reviews.author: Alan C

reviews.title: Travelers Beware: YouTube reviews are paid ads.
reviews.text: After flying Royal Jordanian, I have determined that only 3 kinds of people who fly RJ. One, those who are traveling to Amman/Jordon. Second, those whose flight schedule matches RJs schedule. Third, those who are fooled into believing from online reviews and YouTube that it is good. Truth is I dreaded flying back. The aircrafts are almost as old as the Wright brothers plane, no in all seriousness the planes are 20+ years old but they look like 50+. The food was absolutely horrible, but what takes the cake is the crew members service. They are blatantly rude to everyone. They didnt serve water even once during our 11+ hours flight, and when people did they were horrible to them. You are better off taking an Iraqi, Yemeni, or Syrian. They are just one step above Egypt Air. Please avoid it.
reviews.author: Zams

reviews.title: Absolutely the Worst
reviews.text: Royal Jordanian airlines is the worst airlines I have ever been on. The food was absolutely disgusting like something you would feed prisoners or something. On top of that I opened my meal and a fly flew out. The fly proceeded to fly around my food and terorrize the people around me. The flight attendant said the food is warmed for 25 mins so not sure how a fly could survive. Mind you we are 1 hour into the flight and over 10,000 feet in the air. I have never seen a fly on an airplane. The food was terrible and everyone finished rather fast and the food was stacked on the ground and in corners so that people could get up and go to the bathroom. The staff took an hour to collect the food. They needed more assistance to remove the trays at a faster pace. The bathrooms were dirty,stink and was unkept. The seats were small, uncomfortable and they provided no amenities like slippers or a mask like most other lines provide for extended duration flights. The movie selection was very limited with outdated selections. I would never fly royal Jordanian unless it was the absolute last option. There is nothing Royal about Royal Jordanian. The only good thing about the flight was that it was nonstop.

reviews.title: Worst Experience and Worst Airline
reviews.text: Worst Experience I have had in my 45 years of airline travel with Royal Jordanian. Will never travel on this airline. I felt that there is a lot of issue with your Cabin Crew. We felt that they have been trained adequately to serve the passengers. We also felt that the food served was very bad. We asked for HNML (Hindu Meal) and we got some food we never ate at all in our life with some chicken fry and something else. Not sure what it was. This was on the flight on March 12th from DOHA- AMMAN-CHICAGO. The food was same on both the flight for all three meals (1 for Breakfast, 2 from AMMAN to CHICAGO). We also asked for some snacks in-between they did not have nothing, no juices, nothing was served. Only Peanuts, that too I had to beg to give it to me. I am a diabetic patient, we thought of buying our own snacks and getting in as we knew that our TRIP from ORD - DOHA Itself was bad and until AMMAN, there were only 2 meals provided and nothing, just providing everyone with WATER. No Juice also, while going from ORD - AMMAN there were Juice but nothing else. It is a horrible experience. The seats are torn they cleanliness is bad. It is not clean at all. I have never seen an airline so bad. I have been flying for 45 years first time in Royal Jordanian, I had my bad taste of this airline and cabin crew. Your Jordanian men are not at all efficient and are not serving the customer, they are all busy either sleeping to take turns or in the kitchen area. I am sorry I am complaining, bu

Just a wonderful experience, would definitely recommend this airline based on service and humanity
reviews.author: Yusuf W

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: If there was a negative rating I would give a -1 star. We recently booked a flight with RJ for or return flight to the US. We had an issue since the flight itinerary was from Cairo to Amman, then Amman to US, however we were already in Amman and we went to the sales office in the Amman International Airport to ask for help in our issue. The customer service at the office was horrible, the 2 persons treated us bad; first they told us to come back in half and hour to check again for no reason, then when we came back to the office for help, they started to talk each other in Arabic and kind or laughing for our situation, and in this second time they did not really offered any help or ideas on how to solve our issue. My wife and I felt treated harshly from the persons attending in that office. We ended up purchasing tickets in another airline so we could flight back to the US that day, losing our initial tickets purchased from RJ. Definitely I would never recommend to anyone flying on this airline as the customer service is the worst, they have incompetent people working on customer service offices in the airport, those persons show a very bad side of the airline, definitely I would not have this kind of customer facing operators serving in there. For these reasons and my recent experience I would never use again neither recommend anyone flying with RJ airlines.
reviews.author: Luis A

reviews.title: Avoid This Airlines If You Can
reviews.text: I travel to Jordan for work frequently and every time travel books a flight something always goes wrong. So far out five (5) flights all have been terrible. Royal Jordanian Airlines is highly incompetent and disorganized. I’ve had better experiences with Uzbek Airlines and smaller carriers than this airline. 1) Staff needs to have a SOP for business task to be better organized on requirements to check luggage, boarding, and being educated on travelers visa requirements. 2) The airplanes being flown are older and need of remodeling or replacement. Again, I use Uzbek Airways (Tashkent, Uzbekistan) as a example. Avoid this carrier if you can, but a lot of flight into Amman are don’t by Jordan Airlines
reviews.author: Aylon_Davis

reviews.title: Round Trip from Chicago to Amman
reviews.text: First time travelling with Royal Jordanian and I had high expectations. I did not have a pleasant experience and being a regular traveler with Etihad/Qatar/Emirates, the comparison of the flying experience with Royal Jordanian was very poor. Few notes - Went to the bathroom and found the tissue box inside the toilet, the air-hostess was nearby and mentioned this to her, she went in took the box and just placed it back in the shelf! talking about hygienic sense here! We had requested vegetarian food and the food quality is very bad! to add salt to the wound they repeat the same food for both lunch and dinner! for the amount of money we pay, can't they provide a decent tasting meals? I have to say that when I pointed this to the air-hostess she offered to provide me with a chicken Pizza! I guess this will be the last time I will be choosing this airline! The seats are terrible, extremely cramped and the upkeep of the plane as well as lavatory upkeep was very bad.
reviews.author: Ram S

reviews.title: Never waist your money with Royal Jordanian
reviews.text: Over the last 20 years, I have flown with many airlines carriers. And every time I fly with RJ, I end up having a minor problem that soon becomes a major problem. I always remind myself not to fly with them again, but sometimes I have no other option.....I regret every flight I had with them!!

reviews.text: The worst customer support, before I travel I contacted them to check about the regulation for covid , they said I don’t have to do pcr anymore, I went to the airport and couldn’t catch my flight because of that, and paid extra fees inorder to get my money back, they just refunded money now after one year of chasing, and only refunded 1,700 dhs out of 5,000 dhs paid for 2 tickets and they said this is the only refund i will get, Don’t use this airline , even the plane was the worst plane ever to try

reviews.title: Worst airline ever.  Lied to by agents.
reviews.text: These people are horrible! The agent told me the wrong time to be at the gate. I asked twice because it seemed wrong, but the agent arrogantly insisted. I got there 10 minutes before he told me to be at the gate but they had closed the doors and wouldn't let me on. No apology even when it was clearly bad info from the agent. I missed my connection to the states and its going to cost me hundreds of dollars for an extra night hotel and airport transfers. The worst part is that the agent lied and refused to admit he had given me the wrong time. I looked him in the face and asked him "Are you really going to lie to my face?" He looked embarrassed but never admitted his mistake to his boss.
reviews.author: BDclimber

reviews.title: Staff unable to accept their errors
reviews.text: We had booked extra leg room seats through our travel agent but were checked in to normal ecommomy seats. We only realised this on boarding and advised the flight crew accordingly. They were not simpathetic and we were forced to stay in the normal seats for the whole flight only being seen by the flight manager half way through. Our agent managed to get a refund and admission of fault from the airline but then we received an insulting email falsly claiming that we had been moved fom the exit row seats by the crew as we were not suitable for hese positions (we do meet all of RJA's requirements) and were therefore not even entitled to a refund. Further correspendence resulted in even more lies from their service desk. It would seem that saving face is more important to the airline than giving an apology for the por treatment of passengers
